draft.emotion: warm and affectionate, speaking of one's own child
notes: Literally 'con' (offspring) + 'trai' (male). In the general sense, it covers both boys and young unmarried men, contrasting with 'con gái'.

examples.text: Ông ấy có hai đứa con trai.
examples.emotion: proud and happy, sharing family news with a friend

senses.definition: A male child or young man.

examples.text: Con trai thường thích chơi bóng đá.

draftBefore.emotion: warm and affectionate, speaking of one's own child
notes: In Vietnamese, 'con trai' serves a dual purpose: it means both 'son' (relative to a parent) and 'boy' or 'male child' in general. Context will usually make it clear which meaning is intended.

examples.text: Ông ấy có hai đứa con trai.
examples.emotion: proud and happy, sharing family news with a friend

senses.definition: A male child or young male human.

examples.text: Đứa con trai đang chơi bóng đá ngoài sân.

faults.quote: In Vietnamese, 'con trai' serves a dual purpose: it means both 'son'

faults.quote: Đứa con trai đang chơi bóng đá ngoài sân.
